subject: general
question: Which of the following organisations in India developed the world’s highest-resolution weather forecasting model in May 2025?

options.text: National Centre for Medium Range Weather Forecasting (NCMRWF)

solution:
The Correct answer is __**Indian Institute of Tropical Meteorology (IITM)**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The **Indian Institute of Tropical Meteorology (IITM)**, located in **Pune, Maharashtra**, is a premier research institute dedicated to studying and understanding tropical meteorology and weather-related phenomena.
 
• In **May 2025**, IITM developed the **world’s highest-resolution weather forecasting model**, showcasing its advanced capabilities in meteorological research and technology.
 
• This model provides **precise weather predictions**, aiding in disaster management, agriculture planning, and other critical sectors.
 
• IITM operates under the **Ministry of Earth Sciences**, Government of India, emphasizing its importance in national-level weather forecasting and research initiatives.
 
• The institute is also known for its work on **monsoon studies**, climate change research, and development of models for understanding atmospheric dynamics.
 
• IITM has played a crucial role in establishing **state-of-the-art computing facilities** for weather prediction and climate modeling.
 
• Collaborating with international organizations and institutes, IITM contributes to global meteorological advancements.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

__
 
• **National Centre for Medium Range Weather Forecasting (NCMRWF)**__

 __
 
• The **NCMRWF** is a scientific organization under the **Ministry of Earth Sciences**, Government of India.
 
• It specializes in **medium-range weather forecasting** using numerical models and data assimilation techniques.
 
• NCMRWF contributes to improving the accuracy of weather predictions over a span of 3 to 10 days.
 
 
 
• **India Meteorological Department (IMD)**__
 __
 
• The **IMD** is India’s national meteorological service, established in **1875**.
 
• It provides weather forecasts, warnings, and climate data for the country.
 
• IMD is responsible for monitoring cyclones, tsunamis, and other extreme weather events.
 
 
 
• **Indian Space Research Organisation (ISRO)**__
 
 
• **ISRO** is India’s space agency, known for its advancements in satellite technology and space exploration.
 
• It plays a significant role in **space-based weather monitoring** through satellites such as INSAT and GSAT series.
 
• Though not directly involved in developing weather models, ISRO supports meteorological studies via satellite data.
